title: Peter Thiel almost intercepted over energy technology

tellings.quote: I was I got a heads up from the the senior MOCI guy and I back channel that information to Eric Weinstein.

plain: Steven Greer, a longtime UFO activist, says the tech investor Peter Thiel was nearly intercepted, or stopped, because of his interest in a secret energy technology. Greer says he got a warning from a senior insider in a group he calls the MOCI, which he does not spell out here, and quietly passed it on to the mathematician Eric Weinstein. If true, it would mean powerful people are watched and blocked when they get near hidden energy secrets.
